breakdown.description: Otto cycle is defined incorrectly (Otto has constant-volume heat addition, not constant-pressure).
breakdown.reason: The generated specification silently dropped 'constant-pressure heat addition' but did not explicitly correct it by stating that Otto cycle has constant-volume heat addition, nor did it identify that constant-pressure heat addition corresponds to a Diesel cycle, as the ground truth requires.

breakdown.description: Efficiency formula is applied for a different cycle than described.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification simply applied the Otto formula to the Otto cycle without addressing the original mismatch. The ground truth requires identifying that constant-pressure heat addition is a Diesel cycle and that the Diesel efficiency formula should be used in that case. The generated spec does not mention the Diesel cycle or its formula at all.
